home.hero: Sleepy Bedtime Stories Made Just For Them.
home.heroSub: Create calming, personalised bedtime stories starring your child - with their favourite toys, animals, and gentle adventures woven into every page. Read them aloud, listen with narrated audio, or order a real hardcover book.
home.featureSub: Every detail that makes your child unique goes into every story.
home.feature1Desc: Add your child's name, age, favourite toys, animals, gentle lessons, and optional illustrated references from clear photos.
home.feature2Desc: AI weaves their world into a calming bedtime story designed to end softly and help little listeners settle.
home.feature3Desc: Generate full AI artwork for every page spread, with optional child and Family & Friends references for more consistent characters.
home.feature4Desc: Order a real printed hardcover delivered straight to your door. Choose 1–10 copies. Printed and shipped across Australia.
home.feature6Desc: Read illustrated stories from other Storycot families, vote for monthly favourites, and earn credits when your own story is featured.
home.themesSub: Choose a theme and the story naturally teaches it.
home.ctaSub: Create a child profile, pick a theme, and have a magical story ready in under a minute.
home.arcTitle: Every story has a perfect arc.
home.arcSub: The AI follows a proven structure that keeps kids engaged and ends with calm.
home.footerTagline: Personalised bedtime stories for the little ones you love.
home.feature5Desc: Tap play and the story reads itself aloud - with each word lighting up as it is spoken. Perfect for bedtime on any device.
